name: Copenhagen Plank
steps: Lie on your side perpendicular to a sturdy bench with your bottom forearm beneath your shoulder and your top inner ankle or knee resting on the bench.
Brace your core, press your top leg firmly into the bench, and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Raise your lower leg slightly off the floor to hover beneath the bench while keeping your pelvis stacked.
Hold steadily for the target duration, lower your hips gently, and switch sides.
tips: Keep your shoulders, hips, and ankles aligned in a straight line without letting your hips sag downward.
Rest your top knee on the bench to shorten the lever if the straight-leg ankle setup feels too demanding.
